source_mode: Read-only measurement of previously licensed skinned character, rifle and frozen failed hand-wrap calibrations
mode_inference_decision: Diagnostic measurement and browser overlay, no production art generation
requirements: Do not alter or rerun sealed hand-wrap or hand-entry experiments
Measure source-start and frozen hand-wrap candidate once each; no angle optimization or candidate export

After the frozen-pose diagnosis, measure exactly four predefined corners: all four long fingers at MCP20/65 by PIP10/70 degrees, DIP=min(45,0.75PIP), preserving each wrap splay. These are rejected-or-unapproved diagnostic poses, never new fit seeds or a feasibility proof
Report geometric distance in metres and normal opposition in degrees separately; no score used as distance
Use reviewed long-finger face IDs and actual deformed triangles; preserve IDs, unique-vertex counts and nearest weapon surface evidence
Measure wrist, palm support point, bone origins, segment lengths and patch centroids in world and weapon-local frames
Record fixed weapon and right hand invariants; retain mesh/UV/weights and runtime hashes
Treat nearest authored surface queries and dominant-weight region selection as limited evidence, not containment or feasibility proof
Independently review measured direction before authorizing any structurally different pose experiment
